suggestion.subject: A slow-living board where week one stays hidden
suggestion.body: Slow-living boards die after week one because nobody wants to post a bad first week. Idea: everyone’s first week stays hidden and unlocks together. I need an illustrator for the board and a host for the weekly check-in. First step: a two-week trial with ten volunteers, starting next Monday.
